title: Haseltine's novel Out of Time hiding truths
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Haseltine's novel Out of Time hiding truths, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: former director of NSA research, Eric Haseltine, who I had on my show. He wrote a a {quote} {unquote} fiction book. I think it was called Out of Time.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about Eric Haseltine, a former director of research at the NSA, the US National Security Agency that handles intelligence from communications, and a past guest on his show. Michels says Haseltine wrote what he calls, with air quotes, a fiction book, which he thinks was titled Out of Time. The hint is that the novel may be a way to tell real things a former official could not say openly.
